Execute multiple analytics queries in parallel

status

POST/api/v1/analytics/batch

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/analytics/dashboard

Get comprehensive dashboard metrics in a single call. Returns sales inc/ex VAT, orders, products, tips, refunds, discounts, AOV, VAT breakdown, time series, top products, top categories, and channel breakdown.

query Parameters

locationId
​number · required

Location ID

startDate
​string · date-time

Start date (ISO 8601)

endDate
​string · date-time

End date (ISO 8601)

includeChildren
​boolean

Include child locations

Default: false
granularity
​string · enum

Time series granularity

Enum values:
hour
day
week
Default: hour
productSearch
​string

Search filter for product titles

productLimit
​number

Max products to return (default 10, max 500)

Default: 10
tableGroupIds
​string

Comma-separated list of table group IDs (storefront_qr_code_groups.id) to restrict results to. When set, excludes orders without a QR code (e.g. pickup, delivery).

costCenterIds
​string

Comma-separated list of cost center IDs (cost_centers.id) to restrict results to. Matches on COALESCE(tabs.cost_center_id, storefront_qr_codes.cost_center_id) — tab override beats table default. Orders without a cost center are excluded when this filter is active.

Responses

Default Response

status
​string · enum
Enum values:
success
​object
​object
GET/api/v1/analytics/dashboard
curl --request GET \ --url 'https://common-api.karma.life/api/v1/analytics/dashboard?locationId=%3Cnumber%3E'
Example Responses
No example specified for this content type
application/json

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/analytics/tips-by-staff

Get tips totals per staff for the period. Tips are split proportionally across staff based on each staff member's share of committed-item revenue on the same tab. Unattributed share (no staff on tab) is returned with retailUserId = null.

query Parameters

locationId
​number · required

Location ID

startDate
​string · date-time

Start date (ISO 8601)

endDate
​string · date-time

End date (ISO 8601)

includeChildren
​boolean

Include child locations

Default: false
tableGroupIds
​string

Comma-separated list of table group IDs to restrict to.
